description: Data scaler of the forward model, copied from the Phase 2 harness scaler (fitted on the TRAIN split of D_k). ForwardModel applies it internally; the Neural_Adjoint tool reads x_min / x_max as the raw 14-D training range.
formula: x_scaled = (g_raw - x_shift) / x_scale ; y_raw = y_model * y_scale + y_shift   (x minmax: x_shift = (x_min + x_max) / 2, x_scale = (x_max - x_min) / 2, i.e. the training range maps to [-1, 1]; y global_standard: y_shift = mean, y_scale = std of all training absorptivity values, the same for all 2001 points)
